name: Vernon Hills Shopping Center
summary: Vernon Hills Village is an upscale, open-air lifestyle center in Eastchester, NY, featuring a sophisticated mix of retail, dining, and services across five buildings. Recently enhanced with new additions like Nike, Sephora, and Serafina, this premier Westchester County destination offers convenient access to premium shopping just minutes from White Plains.
demographics: Vernon Hills Village attracts an affluent Westchester County demographic, with visitors primarily consisting of middle to upper-income families and professionals from the surrounding communities of Eastchester, Scarsdale, and White Plains. The trade area serves households with above-average incomes who seek convenient access to premium retail brands and dining options. Shoppers tend to be between 30-65 years old, with a mix of working professionals making quick visits and families engaging in longer shopping trips on weekends. The center's proximity to White Plains' business district also draws lunchtime traffic from office workers seeking dining and retail services.
description: Vernon Hills Village is an upscale, open-air lifestyle shopping center strategically located at 700 White Plains Road in the heart of Westchester County, New York. This premier destination consists of five buildings thoughtfully designed to accommodate a sophisticated mix of retail, office, and medical space, creating a vibrant community hub. Situated less than five minutes from White Plains' thriving business district and surrounded by some of New York's most beautiful parks, the center offers an ideal blend of convenience and natural beauty. The shopping center has recently welcomed exciting new tenants including a Nike Store, Serafina restaurant, and Sephora, complementing its already impressive roster of featured destinations. With operating hours from 10 AM to 8 PM Monday through Saturday and 12 PM to 6 PM on Sundays, Vernon Hills Village provides a welcoming environment where shoppers can enjoy premium brands and dining in an attractive outdoor setting that reflects the upscale character of southern Westchester County.
